source_revision: not-reviewed: provider terms not read; automation surface per xAI's Grok Build documentation (docs.x.ai/build/cli/reference and /headless-scripting, retrieved 2026-10-13) as recorded in TDD 4.3, and the 2026-10-14 live checks (docs/research/live-checks-2026-10-14-grok.md, CLI version 1.0.50)
notes: Added by T4.22 (2026-10-14, Delegated agent work, not owner-approved). The range admits no version (ADR-0009, ROADMAP 6.8 conventions): the adapter fails the version gate with ADAPTER_VERSION_UNVERIFIED until `switchboard adapters validate grok` passes a version, so nothing here is a claim that any Grok Build version is validated. Automation surface: `grok --single=<prompt> --output-format streaming-json`, one process per run (TDD 4.3.1 transport decision); `grok version` for the version. Flags cited by TDD 4.3.1 sources [CLI], [HL], [PERM], [SBX], [SET] and observed in the 2026-10-14 live checks: --single, --output-format (plain, json, streaming-json, streaming-messages-json), --sandbox (strict, read-only, workspace; off by default), --allow, --deny, --always-approve (bypass-class, only for an approved privileged scope that sets bypass), --disable-web-search, --resume, --no-auto-update (accepted by 1.0.50, absent from --help). Never emitted: --trust, -w/--worktree, --fork-session, --permission-mode, --yolo, --dangerously-skip-permissions, any catch-all allow rule; XAI_API_KEY and GROK_HOME stay out of the environment (ADR-0003). Compile matrix (Delegated, fail closed, from the live check): inspect-untrusted, edit-untrusted, test-sandboxed and trusted-development are Ineligible (PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED): `--permission-mode dontAsk` did not deny a plain command without an allow rule, `--deny` rules are prefix matches (`git -C . commit` and `/usr/bin/git commit` created commits), and `auth.json` is readable from inside --sandbox strict and workspace. privileged compiles only for an approved scope with bypass true, shell broad, network off or on (allowlist is Ineligible), repository_config enabled and no requested model; the sandbox profile is compiled with --always-approve, never one without the other. Auth (Q-10, T4.24): the adapter runs `grok models`, whose exit code is 0 whether logged in or not (observed on 1.0.50), so only a first stdout line that starts with `You are logged in` (OK) or `You are not authenticated` (AUTH_REQUIRED naming `grok login`) decides, at exit 0; any other output, exit code, timeout or spawn failure is UNKNOWN (fail closed). The text is an observation of one version, not a documented contract. Parser (T4.23): reads only the `streaming-json` fields the live check recorded (`end` with `sessionId`, `stopReason` and usage; `text`; `error`); `tool_call` and `tool_call_update` lines are unknown events until a capture records them, so Switchboard's tool-call guard cannot see commands yet; resume is `-r <id>`. Git writes (FR-GIT-01): no declared control (ADR-0039); commitChannel finalize-only (no per-run MCP definition flag). Credentials: Switchboard never reads, copies, logs or exports Grok credentials (including ~/.grok/auth.json), never starts login and never scrapes dashboards (ADR-0003, FR-AUTH-02). Terms: this manifest records that the CLI documents headless use (technical evidence only); it makes no claim that any use complies with xAI's terms (NFR-COMP-01). Review date: 2026-10-14 (Delegated agent review, not owner-approved). Linux only; macOS (NFR-PORT-02) and Windows (NFR-PORT-03) are not supported.
